messages.content: Can you take a partner integration?
Yes, taking a partner integration.
Anything broken?
I updated gateway/kong.yaml.
Where are we?
Nobody needs to think about cursor-based pagination across all list endpoints anymore. Request/response logging with PII stripped came off the board this morning.
Next steps for a partner integration?

CI is passing. Per-key rate limits with headers exposing the budget has been live since Tuesday with no complaints. HMAC-SHA256 for webhook signatures is the direction we committed to. See the diff in api/ratelimit.py.
What if we went with URL-based versioning over header negotiation?
The bulk of the diff sits in tests/test_webhooks.py. Complete: an API changelog published with each release. I'll post a recap later. Fine by me.
Anything broken?
The team picked JSON only, no XML support. Ping me if anything seems wrong. Outage: rate limit headers reporting a stale budget.
Blockers?
Nobody needs to think about idempotency keys on all write operations anymore.
Next steps for a partner integration?
Documenting the webhook replay procedure is still owed to the client.
My preference would be snake_case field naming throughout.
We resolved to use a six-month deprecation window. I've locked in cursor pagination rather than offset. Nothing is waiting on anyone at the moment. Makes sense, doing that.
Anything broken?
The sandbox environment for partner testing came off the board this morning. Support tickets mention webhook deliveries duplicated after a consumer timeout.
